title: CA Group Australasia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Global Alloys

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: CA Group Australasia Pty Ltd (CA Group) proposes to acquire the Global Alloys business from Casting Components & Alloys Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the following markets: - a national market for the manufacture and supply of cast non-ferrous metal products; and - a national market for the manufacture and supply of extruded non-ferrous metal products.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. In forming this view the ACCC considered that the following factors were likely to constrain the merged entity: - the continued presence of a number of competitors; - sufficiently low barriers to entry and expansion, which would enable some competitors to modify their manufacturing activities to compete with the merged entity; and - the availability of imports for some customers.
